convergence.description: Gate config-done on the MPLS L3VPN converging (test-suites v2, contract delta 17). PUTs onto examples/mpls-l3vpn.yml. Show-based (no live ping): asserts the programmed state — OSPF adjacency, LDP session via vtysh JSON + compare, VPNv4 sessions Established toward every remote PE (peer addresses rendered from the lab's facts), and a label-switched VRF route toward each remote customer site (VRF loopbacks rendered too — nothing hardcoded). Every `run` keeps the DEVICE-KEYED dict form even though only the vyos flavor ships today: the second flavor was Cisco IOL, withdrawn 2026-08-05 on CML licensing (ROADMAP 17.1), and a node whose device has no case reports `skip`, so adding a flavor back is a one-key edit.

ospf_full.description: Every node has a Full OSPF adjacency (the area-0 core is up).

ldp_operational.description: Every node has an operational LDP session (MPLS transport LSPs up).

vpnv4_established.description: pe1's VPNv4 iBGP sessions to every other PE are Established with routes received — peer addresses rendered from the lab's facts.

vyos.command: vtysh -c "show bgp ipv4 vpn summary json"

fib_reach_pe1_to_pe4.description: pe1's VRF FIB label-switches toward pe4's customer site (VPNv4 imported + LSP programmed) — the customer loopback rendered from the facts, not hardcoded.

vyos.command: vtysh -c "show ip route vrf vpn_a {{ nodes.pe4.vrfs.vpn_a.loopback_address.ipv4 | address }}"

fib_reach_pe4_to_pe1.description: pe4's VRF FIB label-switches toward pe1's customer site (reverse path).

vyos.command: vtysh -c "show ip route vrf vpn_a {{ nodes.pe1.vrfs.vpn_a.loopback_address.ipv4 | address }}"

reachability.description: On-demand cross-VPN traffic proof: ping pe4's customer loopback from inside pe1's VRF (and back). Live traffic, so a runtime suite, not a config-time gate.
